messages:
sec-bot: [ALERT] Unusual KMS decrypt requests from svc-account-analytics at 2024-07-01T02:15:40Z. Count=237 in last 5m. Trigger: anomaly-detection-3.

jess_oncall: I'm taking IC. Creating war-room. @maria_sec @kevin_infra please join. High priority.

maria_sec: joining. Need log samples and request IDs. Any evidence of privilege escalation?

kevin_infra: joining. Pulling CloudTrail/KMS logs now. If confirmed, we will rotate the key and revoke temporary creds.

jess_oncall: timeline: detection 02:15 UTC -> confirm 02:20 -> containment actions started 02:23.

sophie_prod: noticed increased downstream errors in hosted-api; could be cascade. Putting a throttling rule on analytics route.

jess_oncall: action list: 1) capture logs 2) block svc-account-analytics 3) rotate KMS key 4) collect host forensics 5) comms draft. Assigning.

maria_sec: I'm on logs + vuln triage. Can someone snapshot IAM policies for svc-account-analytics?

kevin_infra: snapshot done: iam_snapshot_20240701.tar.gz uploaded to s3://redwood-sec/forensics/1719876543. Also saved CloudTrail -> cloudtrail_1719876543.json

jess_oncall: temp-blocking service principal at org level. Command run: ```gcloud iam service-accounts disable svc-analytics@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com```

kevin_infra: disabled the service account. Confirmed requests stopped at 02:24:12 UTC.

sec-bot: Note: KMS key usage spike halted after SA disable. Decrypt attempts dropped to baseline.

maria_sec: collecting list of resources accessed with that SA in last 24h. Also pulling RBAC delta (recent role binds) — any infra changes in last 48h?

kevin_infra: recent RBAC change by devops-ci: added roles/storage.objectAdmin to svc-analytics on 2024-06-30 18:02 UTC. Pushing PR to revert.

sophie_prod: I've applied routing fallback: analytics->cached responses to reduce load. Monitoring error rate.

jess_oncall: comms: Safety: internal-t1:notify-security, product leadership. No external customer impact confirmed. Draft posted in #incidents: https://redwood.incidents/1719876543

maria_sec: Forensics note: preserving KMS key metadata and key version. Decided to not immediately rotate to preserve logs; we'll rotate after key material export isn't needed. Recommend creating a new key and re-encrypting objects.

kevin_infra: KMS rotation plan: create key 'data-prod-rot-20240701', rewrap top-level secrets, and schedule cutover. Est. 2 hours.

jess_oncall: decision: 1) keep current key for now (preserve logs) 2) disable service account 3) start rewrap job 4) run vulnt triage for any exploited path. Vote: +1 from maria, kevin, sophie.

maria_sec: starting vuln triage. Looking at CVE exposures on analytics container images. Will open issues for any findings.

kevin_infra: handoff plan: I'm taking second shift. Will stay until rewrap completes or 04:30 UTC. @jess_oncall will provide summary and handoff note.

jess_oncall: handoff summary: detection->confirmed->disabled SA->logs collected->RBAC revert PR opened->rewrap started. Next steps for Kevin: complete rewrap, rotate keys, produce timeline for postmortem. I'm pausing IC and assigning Kevin as IC for follow-up.

kevin_infra: acknowledged. I'll update this thread with progress.

pager-duty: Incident ticket #INC-2024-345 created and linked to this thread.
